title: Direct Data-Driven Linear Quadratic Tracking via Policy Optimization
summary: Direct data-driven optimal control provides an elegant end-to-end paradigm, yet its real-time applicability is often hindered by the growing dimensionality of online decision variables. Recent breakthroughs, notably Data-EnablEd Policy Optimization (DeePO), overcome this bottleneck for the Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) through sample-covariance parameterization; however, extending this paradigm to Linear Quadratic Tracking (LQT) poses a fundamental challenge. The core difficulty stems from the intricate coupling between time-varying references and the feedback-feedforward policy…
